positive_snippets: Good hotel with clean rooms and a comfortable stay. Staff is polite and helpful, and the overall atmosphere is pleasant. Location is convenient, and services are satisfactory. A little improvement in amenities or food options would make it even better. Overall, a nice place to stay. 👍🏨
Is a good hotel with a good location. Service is good and people is very kind. They have a very good food and options in case you prefer no too spicy.
The place was very clean. The service was quick and the food was as good as you'll find in a week established hotel chain. Must stay if you're around to attend an event.
